metadata.abstract: A feasible assignment and a dual feasible solution certify optimality when their costs agree. This demonstration presents a three-by-three example, explains its exact certificate, and distinguishes mathematical certificate verification from manuscript evaluation. The English revision adds a figure and explicit provenance declarations; it claims no novel research contribution.
